decisions.reason: Disabling mobile hover animations does not change the gallery's scrolling mode, tabs, or content organization.
The homepage button destinations are addressed by a separate clause in the message and are unaffected by the mobile hover decision.
The mobile pricing layout request is independent of whether gallery hover animations are enabled on mobile.
Disabling mobile gallery hover animations does not alter the one-time pricing model or pricing-tab visibility.
The source decision concerns gallery hover behavior on mobile and does not change the homepage design direction, image emphasis, or overlay.
Removing a mobile hover interaction does not change the sitewide requirement for image-focused visual design.
The mobile hover decision does not affect itemized service coverage, pricing details, or pricing transparency.
Gallery hover behavior is independent of package counts, square-footage categories, and package prices.
Disabling hover animations on mobile does not change the requirement for each listed service to have a corresponding image.
The candidate requires basic homepage gallery animation but does not establish that this animation is a hover effect; the source decision therefore does not necessarily modify it.
The pricing-detail navigation entry and destination are unaffected by the gallery's mobile hover setting.
The source decision changes a frontend gallery interaction and does not alter the WordPress, hosting, domain, or control-panel configuration.
